subject: Harry Houdini
hook: HARRY HOUDINI IS NOT WHO YOU THINK
angle: Harry Houdini was not just a world-famous escapologist; he was also a pioneering aviator who became the first person to fly a powered aircraft in Australia.
angle_support: He was also a keen aviator and became the first man to fly a powered aircraft in Australia.
title: The Secret Life of Harry Houdini
description: While history remembers Harry Houdini for his death-defying escapes and iron locks, he was also a pioneering pilot. He made aviation history by completing the first powered flight in Australia.
narration: HARRY HOUDINI IS NOT WHO YOU THINK You picture a man struggling against chains in a water-filled milk can. It was closer to a cockpit. He was not just a stuntman; he was an aviator. Long before he became a household name for his escape acts, Houdini bought a Voisin biplane. In 1910, he transported this aircraft to Australia, where he successfully completed the first powered flight ever recorded on that entire continent. The man who mastered the air was never just a prisoner.
